meta.source: benchspec repo docs/assets + scripts/render_assets.py; benchspec watch mockups revision 7; design critique round 1; aesthetic pass (round 4)

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Brand ink: mark brackets and wordmark text on light grounds; social-card wordmark. 14.6:1 on brand-paper. Same hex as dark `surface`.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Brand hue: mark right-column squares 1 and 3 on light grounds. 3.2:1 on brand-paper: marks and large text only, never body text. The light UI `accent` is the deeper #D8430F (≥3.2:1 on every UI ground).

tokens.name: brand-salmon
tokens.usage: Mark middle right-column square, light and dark versions. 1.8:1 on brand-paper: logotype fill only.

tokens.name: brand-gray
tokens.usage: Mark left-column squares, light-ground version. 2.1:1 on brand-paper: logotype fill only.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Social-card background.

tokens.name: brand-slate
tokens.usage: Social-card tagline on brand-paper (7.1:1); the light theme's `muted`.

tokens.name: term-body
tokens.usage: Terminal-render body; the dark theme's `bg`.

tokens.name: term-titlebar
tokens.usage: Terminal title bar; the dark theme's `raised`.

tokens.name: term-text
tokens.usage: Terminal text on term-body (14.9:1); the dark theme's `fg` and the dark wordmark's ink.

tokens.name: term-muted
tokens.usage: Terminal muted text (progress line, rules, report path) on term-body (5.7:1). Dark UI `muted` is the lighter #A8AEBD.

tokens.name: term-prompt
tokens.usage: `$` prompt on term-body (6.2:1); the dark theme's `accent` and the dark mark's orange squares.

tokens.name: term-green
tokens.usage: Terminal report: pass rate ≥80%; positive pp deltas; the PASS state word on a sample line. 7.5:1 on term-body.

tokens.name: term-yellow
tokens.usage: Terminal report: pass rate 50-79%; zero deltas; the TIMEOUT state word on a sample line. 10.0:1 on term-body.

tokens.name: term-red
tokens.usage: Terminal report: pass rate under 50%; negative deltas; the FAIL and ERROR state words on a sample line. 5.0:1 on term-body.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light: warm paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App window, leaderboard, assertion and output lists. Lightest light ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Matrix cells, tiles, title bar, selected segment, select inputs.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hovered cell or row. Hover changes only the ground, never adds a ring. Text ground.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Even leaderboard rows. Text ground.

tokens.name: lbl
tokens.usage: Leaderboard label column and head row. Text ground.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Hover card, lifted above the cells: `hover` in dark, `surface` in light. Always with a 1px `line` border.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, panel borders, progress and group-bar tracks, not-run cell outline, legend top rule. Decorative only: never the sole meaning-carrying mark.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text; grade phase segment. Dark 11.4–14.9:1, light 12.8–15.7:1 on all seven grounds.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: arm lines, eval ids, metric labels, the word `best`, the counter `%`, 100% rates. Dark 6.1–7.9:1, light 6.2–7.7:1.

tokens.name: fg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and outlines: bracketed captions, ranks, timestamps, bracket frames, queued and n/a outlines, prep phase segments, finished group bars. Dark 4.8–6.3:1, light 4.6–5.6:1; 4.55 / 4.28:1 on the line track.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Live progress (live dot, progress fill, running and booting boxes, agent phase segment, in-progress group bars), the selected cell, focus. Nothing else; never text. ≥3.2:1 on all seven grounds and the line track (dark 4.5–6.2:1, light 3.3–4.3:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text: the best leaderboard value and its ◆. Dark 4.8–6.2:1, light 4.9–6.0:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fail and error text: failed and errored tallies, FAIL and ERROR verdicts, hover-card ✗ counts. Dark is a true red (hue 358°), not pink. Dark 4.8–6.2:1, light 4.6–5.6:1. Boxes use status-fail-1/2/3.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Error-box ground. Error ring on it: 5.0:1 dark, 4.7:1 light.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Timeout and quiet: their boxes, hover-card lines, the disconnected banner. The stale top-bar state. Light is amber (#8A5A00), not olive. Dark 7.3–10.0:1, light 4.7–5.8:1, warn-tint included.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Disconnected-banner ground. `warn` on it: 7.3:1 dark, 5.3:1 light.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Finished state; the signed figure of a positive delta (`+34pp`), rest of the delta sentence `muted`. Dark 4.7–6.1:1, light 5.0–6.1:1; ≥3.2:1 on the line track.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Sticky-column edge on the scrolled phone matrix: a `size-shade` gradient from shade to transparent. Decorative.

tokens.name: wm-ink
tokens.usage: Mark brackets and wordmark text in UI chrome and the cover. Matches the wordmark files.

tokens.name: wm-left
tokens.usage: Mark left-column squares. Logotype only: never UI text or a status mark.

tokens.name: wm-right
tokens.usage: Mark right-column squares 1 and 3. Logotype only.

tokens.name: wm-mid
tokens.usage: Mark middle right-column square, same salmon in both themes. Logotype only.

tokens.name: dot-1
tokens.usage: First window title-bar dot. Alias of wm-right.

tokens.name: dot-2
tokens.usage: Second title-bar dot. Alias of wm-mid.

tokens.name: dot-3
tokens.usage: Third title-bar dot. Alias of wm-left.

tokens.name: status-pass
tokens.usage: PASS box: solid square, deliberately quiet (light is lighter than the text ramp). Dark 4.8–6.3:1, light 3.8–4.7:1.

tokens.name: status-fail-1
tokens.usage: FAIL box, lightest step: ≥67% of checks passed. Solid square (StatusBox).

tokens.name: status-fail-2
tokens.usage: FAIL box, middle step: 34–66% of checks passed. Solid square (StatusBox).

tokens.name: status-fail-3
tokens.usage: FAIL box, deepest step: under 34% of checks passed, or a failed single-check eval. Solid square (StatusBox).

tokens.name: status-timeout
tokens.usage: TIMEOUT box fill (StatusBox).

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: ERROR box ring, on danger-tint (StatusBox).

tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: Running box ring and centre dot; booting box dashed ring (StatusBox).

tokens.name: status-quiet
tokens.usage: Quiet box ring and centre bar (StatusBox).

tokens.name: status-queued
tokens.usage: Queued box outline (StatusBox).

tokens.name: status-na
tokens.usage: n/a box outline and slash (StatusBox).

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
families.wordmark: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: bs-type-wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark, outlined to paths in the SVG files (baseline y=43 in the 250x64 viewBox). Brand art only.

styles.name: bs-type-social-wordmark
styles.usage: Social-card wordmark in brand-navy; the only 700 use. Brand art only.

styles.name: bs-type-social-tagline
styles.usage: Social-card tagline, brand-slate on brand-paper. Brand art only.

styles.name: bs-type-terminal
styles.usage: README terminal render, 24px line pitch. Brand art only.

styles.name: bs-type-counter
styles.usage: Run counter digits; `%` at text-24 `muted`. Phone text-30.

styles.name: bs-type-counter-finished
styles.usage: Counter after run end; `%` at text-18 `muted`. Phone text-24.

styles.name: bs-type-metric
styles.usage: Headline number in a hover card or phone leaderboard row.

styles.name: bs-type-value
styles.usage: Leaderboard value, right-aligned; the row's best in accent-ink with ◆.

styles.name: bs-type-group-name
styles.usage: Matrix group summary row label.

styles.name: bs-type-eval-id
styles.usage: Eval id in the drawer header.

styles.name: bs-type-cell
styles.usage: Matrix cell labels and eval row names.

styles.name: bs-type-body-mono
styles.usage: Default app text.

styles.name: bs-type-meta
styles.usage: Arm harness/model lines, table heads, group meta line, footnotes, legend, the word `best`.

styles.name: bs-type-section-label
styles.usage: Bracketed lowercase captions for section heads and the matrix caption, in fg-tertiary.

styles.name: bs-type-heading
styles.usage: Page heading on long-form sheets. Phone text-24.

styles.name: bs-type-title
styles.usage: Section titles and the Finished word.

styles.name: bs-type-status
styles.usage: Drawer status line. Phone text-14.

styles.name: bs-type-body
styles.sample: Write evals as Markdown, run each eval across named benchmark arms.
styles.usage: Prose body text.

styles.name: bs-type-tab
styles.usage: Matrix / Leaderboard tabs.

styles.name: bs-type-explainer
styles.sample: Rates pool only the unscoped lines of each outcome eval.
styles.usage: One-line explanation under a section head, in muted.

styles.name: bs-type-help
styles.sample: No output from a running agent for 30s or more.
styles.usage: Tooltips, hover-card notes, empty states.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tally row gap; box gap and vertical padding in a bracket frame; header line gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Box-to-label gap in a cell; phone cell side padding; caption to content; legend and control gaps; bracket frame side padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Cell side padding; counter gaps; hover-card and list padding; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Matrix column gap; table cell side padding; phone app padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Drawer padding and section gap; tally column gap; cover block inset.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Desktop app padding; tab gap.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Gap between app sections (counter, tabs, matrix).

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Bars (progress, group summary, phase); phone box corners.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Status boxes (the mark's 2.5/10 ratio).

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Buttons, selects, theme toggle, matrix cells, chips.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Hover card, drawer, banners, lists, cards.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Window frames, terminal corners.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, tooltips and the floating desktop Drawer, with a 1px line border.

tokens.name: shadow-hovercard
tokens.usage: Cell hover card (on popover), with a 1px line border. Light is a soft 0 4px 12px.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Phone bottom sheet, with a 1px line border.

tokens.name: size-box
tokens.usage: Sample box in a desktop cell and the legend.

tokens.name: size-box-sm
tokens.usage: Sample box on phone and in four-arm cells.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: Running box centre dot.

tokens.name: size-quiet-bar
tokens.usage: Quiet box centre bar width (2px tall).

tokens.name: size-live-dot
tokens.usage: Top-bar live dot.

tokens.name: size-cell
tokens.usage: Matrix cell and leaderboard row height, desktop.

tokens.name: size-cell-phone
tokens.usage: Matrix cell height under breakpoint-phone.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, selects, tabs, segmented controls, desktop.

tokens.name: size-control-phone
tokens.usage: Controls under breakpoint-phone (touch target).

tokens.name: size-close
tokens.usage: Drawer × close button (square).

tokens.name: size-progress
tokens.usage: Progress bar and phase bar height.

tokens.name: size-group-bar
tokens.usage: Group summary bar height, on a line track.

tokens.name: size-bracket-cap
tokens.usage: Height of the bracket caps around the run progress track.

tokens.name: size-swatch
tokens.usage: Phase-label swatch.

tokens.name: size-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawer width, desktop.

tokens.name: size-hovercard
tokens.usage: Hover card max width.

tokens.name: size-label-phone
tokens.usage: Minimum eval-id column on the phone matrix; pinned when the arms don't fit.

tokens.name: size-arm-phone
tokens.usage: Phone matrix arm column (boxes plus a 4-character rate). Two arms fit 390px without scroll.

tokens.name: size-shade
tokens.usage: Sticky-column shade gradient width.

tokens.name: size-mark-ui
tokens.usage: The mark in the app top bar; its minimum size.

tokens.name: size-wordmark-ui
tokens.usage: Wordmark height in page chrome; 48px in the README.

tokens.name: breakpoint-phone
tokens.usage: Phone layout below this width: `@media (max-width: 639px)`. Media queries can't read custom properties, so bundle.css repeats the value.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines, panel borders, half-height of the timeout bar.

tokens.name: stroke-outline
tokens.usage: Queued and n/a box outlines; the bracket frame; the selected-cell ring.

tokens.name: stroke-ring
tokens.usage: Error, running, booting and quiet rings; focus outline and offset; tab underline.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: The mark's bracket stroke (4 units of 64) drawn as art, e.g. on the cover.

tokens.name: text-12
tokens.usage: meta, section captions

tokens.name: text-13
tokens.usage: body-mono, help

tokens.name: text-14
tokens.usage: cell, group-name, eval-id, body, tab, explainer; status on phone

tokens.name: text-16
tokens.usage: value, status

tokens.name: text-18
tokens.usage: title, the Finished word, the finished counter's %

tokens.name: text-24
tokens.usage: metric, the counter's %; counter-finished and heading on phone

tokens.name: text-30
tokens.usage: counter-finished, heading; counter on phone

tokens.name: text-44
tokens.usage: counter

tokens.name: dur-disclosure
tokens.usage: Disclosure chevron turn and drawer open.

tokens.name: dur-hover-delay
tokens.usage: Delay before a hover card opens on hover or focus.

tokens.name: dur-pulse
tokens.usage: Running dot pulse.
